# The IMAP non-ASCII rename task retains three assertions without messages

The changed non-ASCII rename task still asserts summaryValid, the encoded file leaf name and the displayed folder name without message arguments. Add a nonempty expected-result message to each site so a failure identifies the intended behavior. Nearby test comments and the new assertSettings helper do not supply those messages. New settings assertions have nonempty messages; a missing should alone is not the defect. No unit test ran.

Scope: IMAP rename test diagnostics.
